verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak banner layout: the dark brand block crops the sun logo and leaves SOLSTICE tiny and off-centre, 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' drifts below the dark block, 'Ships late June' breaks onto three lines one word at a time, the legal text is too small to read and is jammed against the right edge, and the CTA is a small button that is outweighed by the body copy. B is worse: its CTA label is squeezed together ('Reservea Case') and the button sits on top of the start of the legal text, a collision that A avoids by stacking them cleanly.
